annotation.title: 251 Beginner Jazz Guitar Lesson. Why is the 251 so important? 🧐
annotation.description:
All of my recent 251 backing track videos have been gearing up to putting this video out. A look at 251 for jazz beginners. I've tried to include what I think is important to know alongside actionable practice points for you to try.


In the video I cover:

* what a 251 is and why it is important 0:55 
*how the 251 functions harmonically 2:17
*playing the 251 progression in all keys 4:55
*playing chord tones over the 251 8:47
*practice approaches to playing chord tones over 251s  11:47
*what scales to use and how to practice them  15:38

Resources can be found over at my website here:https://www.jazzguitarwithandy.com/blog/zo6nn5j7brhg2wba6c6upkx8b3i0ub

You should also check out my 251 backing tracks in this playlist to help you apply what you have learnt. I've put these in  a playlist here:https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLUasKyTkHzN_LJJ08EX7sFPzsHPZS9lRa

It's aimed at those newish to jazz or those getting a bit stuck with 251s and not sure where to head with it. My approach is thorough, you need to be able to play over these with ease, in any key, as they are so common in jazz standards. Yes. it's a lot of work, but my approach is to build a solid foundation to help you be more musical in the long run. It's not about playing licks, it's about understanding the harmony and being able to outline the chords anywhere on the fretboard.

If you have enjoyed today's video then please like and subscribe. I post lessons, gear demos and backing tracks based around jazz and blues guitar. 

Thanks for tuning in, any questions then please a comment. I hope you enjoy the video and gain some value from it.

Andy October 2019.

annotation.title: WE FOUND IT! THE BEST VINTAGE TRAIN STATION IN THE COUNTRY |  STRASBURG RAILROAD | TINY HOUSE VLOG
annotation.description:
Make sure to check out our previous Tiny House and Amish Country Vlogs to get a more in depth look at the Tiny House we stayed in! BUT before you go, don't miss out on the trains in this video, they are incredible. 

Centered perfectly between Hershey, Lancaster, and Pennsylvania's capital, Harrisburg, Tiny Estates is just a short ride away from some of PA's best attractions like Hershey Park! It's also right in the heart of Amish country so be on the lookout for horse and buggies while you're driving around! The farmland is incredible and we truly felt like we were in a place very far from home! Which to us is everything right now! But one of the best attractions and the main subject of this video is Strasburg Train Station. The most authentic old railway, trains, old school conductors, and architecture you've ever seen. One of Walt Disney's favorite places for sure. He actually came here and rode the trains a few times! 

AND because it helps rank our videos on YouTube, don't forget to LIKE, COMMENT, and SUBSCRIBE to follow along to where we travel next! Hopefully we can continue our world travels soon, but until then, we are staying safe and on U.S. soil!
